text:
maria.gomez: Hey support — Acme Inc (acct: acct_9b2) reports 429s on /v1/rerank starting ~2025-11-17T16:40:21Z. They batch ~200 candidates per request, traffic spike to ~1.2k RPS for rerank route. Sample error:

maria.gomez: ```json
{"error":"quota_exceeded","code":429,"message":"rerank request quota exceeded for key acct_9b2"}
```

devon: Can you paste the full curl + response headers? Need x-rw-... headers.

maria.gomez: Response headers show `x-rw-ratelimit-remaining: 0`, `x-rw-ratelimit-reset: 30`, `Retry-After: 30`. Curl we used:

maria.gomez: ```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-acct_9b2" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"find best answer","candidates":["..."],"max_candidates":200}'
```

jordan: This looks like we hit per-key rerank RPM cap. Rerank is rate-limited separately from text-gen. They probably hit a soft limit of 60 rpm or similar depending on contract.

maria.gomez: Customer says they did not change traffic pattern; they did a migration that fans out requests so per-key QPS spiked.

devon: Repro steps for SRE: 1) Use acct_9b2 key (or create a test key) 2) Send 1k req/min with payload max_candidates=200 3) Observe 429s and x-rw-ratelimit-* headers. I'll attach our load script in the case thread.

oncall-sre: Noted. Short term mitigation: 1) advise customer to lower batch size to 50 or shard across multiple API keys 2) use linear backoff honoring Retry-After 3) route to our lighter rerank variant (rerank-lite) if available.

jordan: From platform side: open a quota-escalation for acct_9b2. If customer has a Dedicated plan, fast-track. Also flag billing team if they exceed committed usage.

maria.gomez: Customer asked for a hotfix to avoid NaN/unexpected scores when partial failures occur — they saw some requests return zeroed scores when backend dropped candidates. Is that a separate bug?

devon: Yes file a bug. But first confirm failures are true 429s. If the service returns partial results we should avoid zeroing scores; better to return 429 or a clear error.

support-bot: Ticket created: #SR-20251117-2893 (quota escalation), assigned to quotas@redwood.

maria.gomez: Thanks. I'll inform customer to throttle and we'll follow up with quota team. Will paste load script and customer logs in the ticket.

oncall-sre: Adding runbook items: ensure rerank per-key quotas visible in Console per-route, and add an alert for sudden per-key spikes (>5x baseline in 5m).

devon: @jordan can you approve temporary bump (24h) for acct_9b2 while we investigate?

jordan: Approved. I'll update the escalation ticket.

maria.gomez: :thumbsup: closing loop, will update once customer confirms.
